beats: The basin is dry, but it smells of salt and far water. Something below is listening.

beats.text: It wants an offering: {item:minecraft:nautilus_shell}, {item:cataclysm:athame}, {item:cataclysm:crystallized_coral}, {item:minecraft:diamond_block} and {item:minecraft:heart_of_the_sea}, bound together as {item:cataclysm:abyssal_sacrifice}.
The offering in your pack hums against the stone.
